meta.homeTitle: EVMap for iOS: Find EV charging stations
meta.homeDescription: Ad-free, open source EV charging station finder for iOS. Powered by GoingElectric, Open Charge Map and Nobil with real-time availability and CarPlay support.

home.heroSubtitle: EVMap finds EV charging stations across Europe with live availability. Fast, native and built to respect your privacy.
home.heroNote: Free · iPhone, iPad & CarPlay · iOS 26 or later
home.highlightBody: Open any station to see live availability, every connector and its power, opening hours, photos and pricing. Then start navigation in one tap.
home.featuresTitle: Built for finding a charge, fast
home.featuresSubtitle: A native iOS app with no clutter, no ads and no accounts.
home.featuresMore: And the details that matter: photos, opening hours, charge cards, pricing and Tesla Supercharger availability.

availability.title: Real-time availability
availability.desc: See which connectors are free or in use right now for supported stations across the DACH region, before you drive there.

carplay.title: Apple CarPlay
carplay.desc: Find your next charger straight from your car's dashboard.

search.title: Search anywhere
search.desc: Jump to any address, city or point of interest in seconds.

filters.title: Powerful filters
filters.desc: Plug type, minimum power, network, charge cards, availability and more.

favorites.title: Offline favorites
favorites.desc: Save your go-to stations, sorted by distance and stored on your device.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.desc: No tracking, no analytics. Your location never leaves your phone.

languages.title: 11 languages
languages.desc: Fully localized in German, English, French, Norwegian and more.

free.title: Ad-free & open source
free.desc: Non-commercial and fully open source. No ads, no subscriptions and no hidden costs, ever.

home.screensTitle: Designed to feel right at home on iOS
home.screensSubtitle: Map, station details and filters. Clean, fast and native.
home.sourcesSubtitle: Combine multiple databases for the best coverage wherever you drive.
home.sourcesNote: Enable one or several sources at once. EVMap merges and de-duplicates the results on your map.
home.openSourceTitle: Inspired by the original EVMap for Android
home.openSourceBody: This native iOS app is a port of EVMap, the popular open source Android app by Johan von Forstner (MIT License). Same idea and same data sources, rebuilt natively for iPhone, iPad and CarPlay.
home.ctaSubtitle: Download EVMap and never hunt for a charging station again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: EVMap for iOS does not collect, store, or share any personal data.

location.label: Location
location.desc: Used only on-device to center the map and sort favorites by distance. Never transmitted to the developer.

tesla.label: Tesla account credentials
tesla.desc: If you sign in to your Tesla account, credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain on your device only, used solely to fetch real-time Supercharger availability, and never transmitted to the developer.

filters.label: Filter settings and favorites
filters.desc: Stored locally on your device via SwiftData.

privacy.thirdPartyIntro: EVMap contacts the following external APIs to load charging station data. Your IP address is visible to these services as part of normal network requests.

thirdPartyRows.4: Price comparison (deep-link only, no data sent)

privacy.analyticsBody: No analytics, tracking SDKs, or crash reporting tools are included.
